data.description: While recovering hapuku change 2852, review-bot logs showed repeated 'review-bot webhook: rejected (missing/invalid token)' 401s from the Gerrit compose network address 172.21.0.3. Manual /review/rerun with the SSM token succeeded and the bot voted LLM-Review+1; a host-side comparison also showed SSM, /opt/rebar/infra/compose/.env, the running review-bot container GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN, and refs/meta/config webhooks.config X-Rebar-Token all share the same token hash. This suggests either stale queued webhook deliveries, another webhook source without the header, or a plugin reload/delivery edge. Acceptance criteria: identify the source of the 401 deliveries, prove whether current patchset-created/comment-added webhooks carry X-Rebar-Token, eliminate any stale unauthenticated producer or document it as harmless bounded residue, and add an operator-visible signal if live webhooks are auth-dead while /health remains 200.
data.title: Gerrit webhooks still emit missing-or-invalid token rejects after rotation
